newsitem.title: UK: Croatia issues first-ever international bond.
newsitem.headline: Croatia issues first-ever international bond.

text.p: Croatia on Wednesday issued its first-ever international debt offering, a $300 million five-year Eurobond.
UBS and Merrill Lynch announced the issue, which will offer a yield of 80 basis points more than comparable U.S. Treasury notes.
Croatia last month received "investment grade" credit ratings from the major international rating agencies, pleasing roatian officials who said it would help them attract investment from abroad.

Moody's Investors Service assigned Croatia a sovereign foreign currency rating of "Baa3" and Standard & Poor's rated it "BBB minus", both of which were at the lower end of the agencies' investment grade scales.
The deal followed extensive investor presentations in Europe, Asia and the U.S. The issue size was slightly larger than the $250 million first mooted.
